messages:
jordan: hey — small but real pain: SDKs expose different error primitives. py raises AuthExpired, go returns raw 401 body, js returns mixed keys. hard to write uniform retry/UX policies. any appetite for a compact canonical error body + language-native typed exceptions?

maya: yes please. we had to special-case auth errors in the mobile client because shape differed per SDK. a tiny contract would save a lot.

trent: proposal: runtime always returns a compact JSON: {type, status, message, error_class, retryable, retry_after_seconds?, hint_code?, doc_url?}. SDKs convert to native exception classes but keep the raw JSON on the exception.

jordan: i like that. keep enum-like `error_class` (auth, permission, rate_limit, user_input, not_found, conflict, transient). apps can switch on that.

maya: streaming note: mid-stream faults should include same shape plus optional `stream_offset`/`resume_token`. SDKs expose StreamInterruptedError with those fields.

dev-bot: test suggestion: add a small CI matrix that posts canonical bodies and asserts each SDK surfaces `error_class` and `retryable` correctly.

trent: mapping draft for runtime: 400->user_input(false), 401/403->auth/perm(false), 404->not_found(false), 409->conflict(false), 429->rate_limit(true, use Retry-After if present), 5xx->transient(true).

maya: UX copy: dev logs should be explicit ("AuthError: token expired (401)"); end-user strings should be curated in docs/strings ("Session expired — please sign in").

jordan: next step — i can draft a short RFC and example SDK patches. who wants to coauthor runtime tests?

trent: i'll own the runtime test matrix and CI. maya can do js/mobile SDK updates.

jordan: great — i'll open ticket DX-ERR-2401 and drop RFC link. thanks!

ops-bot: Created ticket DX-ERR-2401: "Canonical SDK error body + typed exceptions" assigned to jordan, trent, maya.
